title: 十页记录

lines.text: 杰克第一次在公司的会上做记录。小雨告诉他：“只要记重点，比如谁决定了什么，什么时候交货。”
lines.py: Jié kè dì yī cì zài gōng sī de huì shàng zuò jì lù. Xiǎo yǔ gào su tā: “zhǐ yào jì zhòng diǎn, bǐ rú shéi jué dìng le shén me, shén me shí hou jiāo huò.”
lines.en: Jack is taking the minutes at a company meeting for the first time. Xiaoyu tells him, "Just note the main points — who decided what, and when the goods are due."
